savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: The following Executive orders, or sections thereof, which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:

transfer_provisions.quote: the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act that are applicable to the committees listed in section 1 of this order, except that of reporting annually to the Congress, shall be performed by the head of the department or agency designated after each committee
transfer_provisions.to: agency heads for the sixteen sec. 1 committees only; EO 12852 is not among them

conclusion: EO 13138 (signed 1999-09-30, 64 FR 53879-53881) continues sixteen advisory committees to 2001-09-30 (sec. 1), reassigns FACA functions for those sixteen (sec. 2), revokes seven committee orders 'which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed' including EO 12852 as amended (sec. 3(f)), supersedes part of EO 13062 (sec. 4), amends three orders (secs. 5-8) and is effective 1999-09-30 (sec. 9). It has no savings, pending-matter or exception clause. The sec. 2 transfer does not reach the sec. 3 revoked committees.
